item.title: Plugins, Processes, Micro-services, Mono-Repos
item.description: Plugins weren’t really much of a thing until recently in my career. Now that I’ve been exposed to them, they seem to show up everywhere, and for good reason. For a long time, my superficial understanding of plugins was that they were a way to extend the existing functionality of a piece of software. For example, browser extensions let you extend many aspects of the web-browsing experience on top of the browser itself. The browser provides a foundation that handles much of the complexity of the web, and the plugins work off that foundation.
